title: Chapter 147: Fighting Side By Side
content:
Chapter 147: Fighting Side By Side

In the city, the Zerg army attacked the area where the evil god army was most concentrated, and the Zerg dogs cleaned up the blocks one by one.

In urban street fighting, the Zerg has a natural advantage. Various complex environments will not only not affect the combat power of the Zerg, but will be used by the Zerg to increase their combat advantages!

The human army led by Daxia entered the city and quickly passed through the streets full of Zerg, and soon arrived at the front line.

The front area continued to fall on the Zerg biological decomposition liquid sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisk, and the houses on the ground were also covered with residual decomposition liquid.

The Zerg biological reproductive suits on the human army changed into fully enclosed black armor. The biological reproductive suits that belonged to the Zerg units themselves could effectively defend against the damage of the Zerg biological decomposition liquid.

In the areas that the Zerg army had completely occupied, the remaining Zerg biological decomposition liquid was taken to the front line by the Zerg dogs to avoid continuous corrosion and consumption, which wasted resources.

It also opens up a passage for the elite alliance troops that are about to enter. Without the protection of the biological reproductive suit, the Zerg's biological decomposition fluid cannot distinguish between the enemy and us.

The Daxia leader of the human army rushed to the front line of the battle, picked up a shield in his left hand and a delicate crossbow in his right hand.

Crossbows are very common among humans. The structure is not complicated, but the production process is relatively high, and ordinary craftsmen may not be able to make them.

But with the Zerg biological reproductive suit that can change at will, as long as you are familiar with the structure of the crossbow, you can easily change a crossbow.

The quality of the crossbows changed by the Zerg biological reproductive suit can be continuously adjusted. The crossbows of these human soldiers are adjusted to the best state according to the template provided by the witch, and they are extremely powerful!

The weapons and equipment changed by the Zerg biological reproductive suit all have a memory function. After they are finalized, they can be recorded. The next time, you only need to think about it, and you can instantly change the desired weapon, which is very convenient and intelligent.

The hand crossbow in the hands of the human soldiers now was a template of the strongest hand crossbow that Wu Cong had ever seen. After continuous adjustment and testing, he used the special ability of the Zerg biological reproductive suit to solve some of the original defects of the hand crossbow, so that the performance of this hand crossbow reached the strongest state.

Two thousand powerful crossbow arrows were shot at the bear goblin soldiers who were fighting with the Zerg dogs in front. These crossbow arrows basically hit the enemy's vital points accurately, and they cleared a large area of enemies at once.

The human soldiers were divided into teams, jumped onto the houses on both sides of the street, followed the attack rhythm of the Zerg dogs, and continued to shoot the enemies in front.

They all carried Zerg energy coins and could replenish energy at any time. With sufficient energy support, the Zerg biological reproductive suit could continuously proliferate and transform into crossbow arrows, so that the hand crossbow with a high firing rate would not have to worry about logistics.

The human soldiers of Daxia were very strong in themselves. Now they only needed to press the crossbow machine to continuously shoot the enemy. Such a battle was too easy for them.

They were like modern warriors holding rifles with unlimited ammunition, constantly harvesting the lives of enemies from a distance!

The enemy's counterattacks were all thrown javelins. With their strength, they only needed to block with their left hand shield to knock down all kinds of javelin attacks.

With the participation of the human soldiers of Daxia, the Zerg army's advancement speed was greatly accelerated. The evil god army originally gathered here was the most densely populated, but now almost all of them have been wiped out.

...

All the elite troops of the alliance entered the city. After seeing the battle situation in the city clearly, Meng assigned combat tasks to each lord. These lords will lead their troops, either alone or in conjunction with other lords, to support the Zerg puppies in different areas.

"Remember! The elite troops in your hands are the hope of the alliance's future!"

"Self-preservation is the main thing on the battlefield! The Zerg does not need you to sacrifice yourself to win!"

"You are here to see the world! Don't be reckless!"

Meng warned the lords of the alliance for the last time before joining the war.

He communicated with Wu Qing the most, and he was the most clear about many of Wu Qing's ideas.

"Don't worry! Lord Meng!"

The lords of the alliance led their respective armies and rushed to the front line!

Beside these alliance lords, there was a Zerg host following them, which was used to communicate with each other on the battlefield.

The battlefield in the city separated the forces of both sides, and the elite troops of the alliance could only act separately. In order to facilitate unified command, real-time communication is essential. These hosts are used to ensure real-time communication on the battlefield.

In addition to the feather archers using bows and arrows and the stone tribe using hand axes for long-range attacks, the elite troops of the alliance almost all use javelin for long-range attacks.

Javelin is simple to make, powerful, low-cost, and can be manufactured on a large scale.

Javelin is also simple and convenient to use. No matter what kind of troops, you can become a primary javelin thrower with a little training. It can be said that there are many advantages.

Therefore, among the non-regular long-range troops in this world, the most people choose javelin as a long-range weapon, and there are many long-range troops that specialize in using javelin, which are very powerful.

The elite troops of the alliance, led by their respective lords, entered the front line in the fierce battle.

"Everyone, be careful! Don't touch those liquids! Look at what happened to those followers of the evil god!"

"We are not Zerg! We can't resist the corrosion of those liquids!"

After entering the frontline area, the lords began to loudly remind their soldiers to be careful of the Zerg's biological decomposition liquid.

Over their heads, liquid globs kept flying over them, falling into the evil god's army in the distance and exploding, corroding the evil god's believers and soldiers, making them scream and howl, which was horrible to watch!

Such a scene was terrifying, and everyone looked up involuntarily, fearing that the liquid globs would fall halfway!

Fortunately, the Zerg puppies beside them were very considerate, rushing all the way, and somehow brought all the scattered liquid to the front.

"Don't stand there stupidly! Throw spears at the enemy's densely populated area!"

"Don't get too close to the front line! Don't enter the enemy's spear attack range!"

After all, they were all well-trained elite troops. After adapting to the atmosphere of the battlefield, the soldiers put down the large number of spears they carried and began to throw spears at the distant enemies with all their strength!

Although the combat position of the elite troops of the alliance was backward and the lethality of the spears was uneven, it also played a certain role, allowing the Zerg puppies to advance faster.

On such a battlefield, the feather tribe archers led by Yu Chong played a huge role. Their precision shooting and killing effect were no worse than the crossbows of the human soldiers of Daxia.

Moreover, they were more numerous, with a longer range, and the effect of clearing the battlefield was more obvious.

The five troops of the five territories of the alliance that had followed Wu Qing to participate in the camp war all performed very well. After adapting, the other troops also fully exerted their combat power.

Until this time, the total force of the Zerg and the Alliance deployed in the city was close to 300,000. The evil god army, which was at a disadvantage in terms of manpower, lacked the blessing of the faith of the sacrifice. Even with the support of firm faith, the evil god army could not hold the defense line in the city, retreated step by step, and the manpower was rapidly decreasing.
